knowledge:
- key_parameters: files=The input data obtained from the csv files ;; template=A data frame containing information about the individual ddPCR runs ;; numOfMarkers=The number of primary clusters expected according to the experiment setup (can be ignored if template is provided) ;; sensitivity=Tweaks clustering partition (sensible values 0.1 to 2, default 1; higher values divide into more clusters, lower merges them) ;; similarityParam=Threshold for assigning ambiguous rain droplets (default 0.95; ratio of distances between clusters) ;; distanceParam=Ratio for assigning rain between two clusters (default 0.8, where 20% goes to lower and 80% to higher) ;; fast=Run a simpler, 10x faster version using only flowDensity (default FALSE) ;; multithread=Distribute algorithm among CPU cores (not available on Windows, default FALSE) ;; constantControl=The name of a marker used as a constant control for normalization in calculateCPDs
- alternatives: runDensity=Uses flowDensity to find local peaks, preferred for quick overview or clean data (run when fast=TRUE) ;; runSam=Uses SamSPECTRAL for spectral clustering, preferred for complex cluster shapes ;; runPeaks=Uses flowPeaks for k-means and density peak finding, alternative clustering approach
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing multiplexed, non-orthogonal ddPCR data (up to 4 targets per reaction) to automatically cluster droplets, assign targets, and calculate copies per droplet (CPD) without manual gating.
- pitfalls: multithread=TRUE is not supported on Windows platforms ;; Setting similarityParam too low (near 0) results in none of the rain droplets being counted, while setting it to 1 counts all droplets regardless of ambiguity ;; fast=TRUE is faster but may miss complex clusters compared to the full ensemble algorithm

workflows.name: ddpcr_clustering_and_analysis
workflows.intent: Automatically cluster ddPCR droplet amplitudes, assign targets, and calculate copies per droplet (CPD) using a template.
input: csv (raw droplet amplitude files from Bio-Rad QX100/QX200)
csv (run template file containing well, sample type, number of markers, and marker names)
workflows.stages: 1. Load raw ddPCR amplitude files using readFiles ;; 2. Load the experiment template using readTemplate ;; 3. Run the main clustering and target assignment algorithm using ddPCRclust ;; 4. Visualize the clustered droplets using ggplot2
workflows.code:
library(ddPCRclust)
# Read files
exampleFiles <- list.files(paste0(find.package('ddPCRclust'), '/extdata'),
                           full.names = TRUE)
files <- readFiles(exampleFiles[3])
# To read all example files uncomment the following line
# files <- readFiles(exampleFiles[1:8])

# Read template
template <- readTemplate(exampleFiles[9])

# Run ddPCRclust
result <- ddPCRclust(files, template)

# Plot the results
library(ggplot2)
p <- ggplot(data = result$B01$data,
            mapping = aes(x = Ch2.Amplitude, y = Ch1.Amplitude))
p <- p + geom_point(aes(color = factor(Cluster)), size = .5, na.rm = TRUE) +
     ggtitle('B01 example')+theme_bw() + theme(legend.position='none')
p
